# Dust

**Object:** all dust layers: void dust (distant / mid / ambient spin), menu dust, album and poster lit dust · Kodi: dialog `1114` (`Custom_1114_Dust.xml`, persistent, zorder 0, **generated by `gen_dust46.py`, do not hand edit**), `Includes_Dust3.xml` (`BezelLitDust`, `BezelLitDustP`), ambient-below copy in Includes_Bezel, menu dust `BzMMDustA`
**Where:** the black space around the strip, art and mini player on every Bezel screen after the splash; over the big album and the poster (lit dust)
**Last updated:** 2026-11-04 · 5.33.473 · **Status:** live · **Lock:** none

## Simple
Fine dust drifts slowly in the black parts of the screen, in a few depth layers, and a slow spinning layer turns behind it. It starts once after the splash and keeps drifting through every screen change, so it never restarts or jumps. Over the big album and the poster, a "lit" dust (the same look as the menu dust) glints inside the glare, with two spin discs turning in opposite directions. All of it is decorative and every layer can be tuned or switched off in the Tuner.

## Feel contract (any framework)

### States
| State | How you get in | How you leave | On screen |
|---|---|---|---|
| Off | splash showing; fullscreen video, slideshow, screensaver, PVR, editors, settings pages, file browser …; Tuner Dust off | conditions clear | — |
| Void dust | any normal Bezel screen | — | distant + mid + ambient spin in the void rectangles |
| Menu dust | MM open | MM closed | menu dust layer |
| Lit dust | big album / poster showing | — | lit dust + 2 spin discs over the art, inside the glare |

### Timeline
| What | Duration | Curve |
|---|---|---|
| Dust appears after the splash | its own fade | sine |
| Drift (slide) speed per layer | Off / Slow / Mid / Fast / Faster | linear |
| Twinkle (fade) per layer | Off / Slow / Mid / Fast / Faster | sine |
| Ambient spin | one turn per 180 s (default) | linear |
| Lit spin disc 1 / disc 2 | album 120 s, poster 240 s per turn (defaults); disc 2 turns the other way at 1.3 × the period | linear |
| Lit dust brightness | follows the glare's pulse (sway clock) | sine |

### Interruptions
- Screen changes: dust keeps its position and motion (no restart).
- MM open: ambient dust under the MM fades by the Tuner rule, except while the Music list is the warm screen behind (stays unbroken with the album).
- Tuner change: the skin reloads; dust restarts once (expected).

### Continuity
- One dust layer for the whole app; it is never torn down between screens.
- Lit dust rides the sway clock: never hide a group between the sway and the lit dust (use opacity).

### Layering
Void dust and ambient spin (zorder 0, below every dialog; an optional "below" copy sits under the section content) < section content < big album layer (lit dust inside, above the art under the glare) < MM (menu dust) < chrome.

### Geometry
- Void dust is clipped to the void rectangles around the strip, art and mini player (one set for the Music list, one for everything else).
- Lit dust: album slots 600 × 600 + spin disc 660; poster slots 588 × 888 + spin disc 920; both discs on the same centre.

### Art
- Void layers: Dust 2.0 sheets (far / mid / spin) at 90 % / 100 % / 125 % particle size.
- Lit dust default "MM" look: textures cut from the MM Dust 2.0 sheets at their MM on-screen scale (mid → slots 1–2, far → slot 3, spin → disc). Alternatives V1.0 (specks) and V2.0 (bake).
- Colour: lit dust uses the glare's mid colour; the two discs together are brighter than one.

### Input
None. Tuner rows (below).

### Speed targets
No frame drops from dust; drift must look continuous.

### Never
- No dust restart or jump on screen change.
- No dust under the splash.
- Lit dust looks like the MM dust by default (462 "i want the same look as mm dust").
- No lit dust out of step with the glare (448, 381).

### Acceptance checks
1. Move between sections: dust keeps drifting, no reset.
2. Open the MM: menu dust appears; ambient doesn't blink behind Music.
3. Watch the big album: lit dust glints in the glare, two discs turning opposite ways.
4. Tuner › Dust › Reset: ambient + distant dust and the spin layer on (470 defaults).

## Kodi implementation (sandbox)

### How it works
- **1114** is a dialog with a `<visible>` (Kodi opens / closes it by condition): `bz_splash_done=1 + !bz_dust_off + !fullscreenvideo + !slideshow + !screensaver + !1113 + …` (PVR, editors, skinsettings, filebrowser, screencalibration …). Two sets of void-rect grouplists: Music list mode (`Window.IsActive(music) + !bz_gridset + !bz_np + empty bz_back …`) and the rest. `bz_amb_below` (+ `!bz_dust_nocut`) draws the ambient below the section group instead.
- **Generated file.** `Custom_1114_Dust.xml` comes from `gen_dust46.py`; `bz_tune_patch.py` patches 1114 and `Includes_Dust3.xml` through a temp file (never in place).
- **Lit dust.** `BezelLitDust` (album; `!bz_adust_off + !bz_dust_off`) / `BezelLitDustP` (poster; `!bz_dust_off`). Textures `$VAR[BzD3LS_*]` / `$VAR[BzD3LSpin]` (album), `$VAR[BzD3PLS_*]` / `$VAR[BzD3PLSpin]` (poster): `Skin.String(bz_at_alitset / bz_at_plitset)` empty = MM (`litmm_a_1..3`, `litmm_a_spin`, `litmm_p_1..3`, `litmm_p_spin`), 1 = V1.0, 2 = V2.0. Spin group: two images, the second `flipx` + `flipy` with the 60 speed / direction rotate conditions mirrored and ×1.3 (468 LITSPIN2); colour `BzD3L_mid` / `BzD3PL_mid`; spin on / off `bz_lspin_off` / `bz_plspin_off`.
- **Exit.** `bz_cmd.py quit/exit` → `Dialog.Close(1114,true)` first.

### Wiring
| Tuner row | Layer | Options | Default (DEF 5.0.20) |
|---|---|---|---|
| d20fdens / d20mdens / d20sdens | distant / mid / spin density | Low · Med · High | Med / Low / Med |
| d20fsize / d20msize / d20ssize / mmdsize | particle size | 90 · 100 · 125 % | 90 / 90 / 90 / 90 % |
| d20fbri / d20mbri / d20sbri | opacity | 10–100 % | 60 / 60 / 70 % |
| d20ffade / d20mfade / d20sfade / mmdfade | twinkle | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Mid / Slow / Slow / Mid |
| d20fslide / d20mslide / mmdslide | drift | Off · Slow · Mid · Fast · Faster | Fast / Slow / Mid |
| spinspd / lspinspd / plspinspd | ambient / album lit / poster lit spin | seconds per turn | 180 / 120 / 240 s |
| d3lit / pd3lit | album / poster lit brightness | % | 60 / 70 % |
| d3lsize / pd3lsize | lit size | Small … | Small / Small |
| Toggles | `bz_dust_off`, `bz_amb_off`, `bz_adust_off`, `bz_spin_off`, `bz_spin_ccw`, `bz_lspin_off`, `bz_lspin_cw`, `bz_d3l0_off` / `l1` / `l2`, `bz_sdust_off`, `bz_fib_off`, `bz_flk_off`, `bz_mmdust_off`, `bz_amb_below` | | 470: ambient, far layer and spin on |
| Presets | `bz_tune.py dust` (subtle / mid / …) | | |
| Menu dust colour | `$VAR[BzMMDustA]` from `bz_at_mmdbright` | | |

### Kodi workarounds (do not port)
- A generated 1114 with fixed void rectangles per mode: Kodi has no masking; a port masks the dust by the layout.
- The "ambient below" duplicate: Kodi can't reorder a dialog under a window's content.
- Patch-and-reload Tuner: Kodi can't change animation times at runtime.
